label: Sign in with Apple client secret (Services ID me.swiftcard.web)
fix: Run `node scripts/apple-client-secret.mjs` (key C8TWRXCNKA in ~/.swiftcard/keys), paste the new JWT into Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Apple, then move this date forward six months. Sign in with Apple stops working the day it lapses.

label: Apple Developer Program membership (Team NHK8FA2RR2)
note: Annual $99 renewal. If it lapses the app is removed from the App Store.

label: LinkedIn posting token (LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN)
note: LinkedIn issues w_member_social tokens with a 60-day life and gives NO refresh token to non-Marketing-partner apps, so this one cannot renew itself. When it lapses, Approve on a LinkedIn item fails with a 401 and posting silently stops. Set `due` to 55 days after the day the token is minted.
fix: Re-mint at https://www.linkedin.com/developers/tools/oauth/token-generator (same app, scopes w_member_social + openid + profile), then `vercel env rm LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN production` and `vercel env add LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN production`, and redeploy. Check any token with https://www.linkedin.com/developers/tools/oauth/token-inspector
